params.linkText: As a member of the Alight Partner Network

children: , Marquee Health is now easier for employees and their families to access through a more connected benefits journey. Personalized coaching, biometric screenings and tailored content help participants identify, build and sustain healthy habits over time.

“Employers are looking for simpler ways to connect employees with health and wellbeing resources that feel relevant, easy to use and measurable,” said Jessica Borchik, SVP, Partner Strategy and Sales at Alight. “We welcome the addition of Marquee Health to the Alight Partner Network, as Marquee reflects our focus on reducing complexity for HR teams while helping employees better understand their health and take meaningful action.”

Alight’s 2026 Employee Mindset Study found that 43% of employees admit delaying or avoiding medical care because it felt too difficult or confusing. By bringing Marquee Health’s biometric screenings, personalized health coaching and wellbeing engagement resources into the Alight benefits experience, employers can make it easier for employees to understand their health, access support, take action and stay engaged over time.

“At Marquee Health, we believe wellbeing programs should be easy to access, simple to manage and meaningful for employees at every stage of their health journey,” said Jonathon Short, President, Marquee Health. “Joining the Alight Partner Network enables us to meet employees within their existing benefits experience, helping employers drive participation while giving employees the support and insights they need to make informed health decisions.”
Learn more about Alight’s Partner Network.

Alight is a leading benefits administration provider of health, wealth, leave and point solutions for many of the world's largest organizations and over 30 million people. Through the administration of employee benefits, Alight helps clients gain a benefits advantage while building a healthy and financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, absence management and navigation. Our Alight Worklife® platform empowers employers to gain a deeper understanding of their workforce and engage them throughout life's most important moments with personalized benefits management and data-driven insights, leading to increased employee wellbeing, engagement and productivity. Learn more at alight.com.

Marquee Health helps employers build healthier workforces through an outcomes-driven suite of biometric screenings, personalized health coaching and tailored wellbeing programs. Designed around each employee’s unique wellness journey, these programs encourage participation and support lasting lifestyle change. Since 2014, Marquee Health has helped millions of employees improve their health and wellbeing. As a CuraLinc company, Marquee Health connects physical health and wellness with a broader portfolio of behavioral health solutions, giving employers a more integrated approach to workforce wellbeing and engagement. It's Wellness, Elevated. Learn more at www.marqueehealth.com.
